name: EH3D-MOTIONCNC
build: cargo build --release --features gui; cargo test --features gui
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.4: the EH3D machine-control program. A window (motioncnc, feature gui) over the controller interface of eh3d-controller in EH3D-COMMON (a sibling folder is needed), working on a simulated machine only: position, jog, zero, home, a line of commands, a G-code program run line by line with pause, stop and the emergency stop, and its path drawn on the table; five themes and eight languages. Nothing has run on a real machine, and no serial port or network connection is opened.
